theaters.title: Piano for Beginners
theaters.titleZh: 初学钢琴 · 音乐的魔力
theaters.tagline: 像勇敢的小演奏家一样，开启神奇的钢琴第一课！

script.text: Good morning, Leo! Are you ready for your first piano lesson?
script.zh: 早上好，里奥！你准备好开始第一节钢琴课了吗？

script.text: Good morning! Yes, I am very excited to play!
script.zh: 老师早上好！是的，我非常期待弹奏它！

script.text: Wonderful. Place your fingers curved on the keys, like holding an apple.
script.zh: 太棒了。把手指弯曲放在琴键上，就像手里握着一颗苹果。

script.text: Like this? It feels very comfortable and fun.
script.zh: 像这样吗？感觉非常舒服而且很有趣！

script.text: Exactly right! Now let us try middle C together.
script.zh: 完全正确！现在让我们一起试着弹响中央C吧。

theaters.title: Eye Test
theaters.titleZh: 视力小测试 · 明亮的双眼
theaters.tagline: 坐在检测椅上，看看最下面一行字母是什么！

script.text: Hello, Emma! Please look straight at the chart on the wall.
script.zh: 你好艾玛！请直视墙上的视力表。

script.text: Okay doctor, I can see the top letters clearly.
script.zh: 好的医生，我能清楚地看到最上面的大字母。

script.text: Can you read the third line from the top for me?
script.zh: 你能帮我读一下从上往下第三行的字母吗？

script.text: Yes! E, T, B, and O.
script.zh: 可以！是 E、T、B 和 O。

script.text: Brilliant! Your vision is very healthy and sharp.
script.zh: 太棒啦！你的视力非常健康敏锐。

theaters.title: At the Butcher's
theaters.titleZh: 在肉铺买菜 · 丰盛家庭晚餐
theaters.tagline: 礼貌向店主叔叔挑选新鲜肉类，做顿美味大餐！

script.text: Good afternoon, young man! How can I help you today?
script.zh: 下午好，小朋友！今天有什么我可以帮你的？

script.text: Good afternoon! Could I have four fresh chicken breasts, please?
script.zh: 下午好！请给我四块新鲜的鸡胸肉，好吗？

script.text: Certainly! Here they are. Would you like anything else for dinner?
script.zh: 当然没问题！给您。晚餐还需要来点别的吗？

script.text: No, that is all. Thank you very much!
script.zh: 不用了，这就够了。非常感谢您！

script.text: Have a wonderful dinner with your family!
script.zh: 祝你和家人享用一顿美妙的晚餐！

theaters.title: A Present for Rose
theaters.titleZh: 准备生日礼物 · 友谊长青
theaters.tagline: 好友生日到了，挑选一份最有心意的小惊喜吧！

script.text: Rose's birthday party is this Saturday! What should we buy her?
script.zh: 罗斯的生日派对就在这个周六！我们该送她什么好呢？

script.text: I think she loves reading mystery storybooks and drawing.
script.zh: 我觉得她特别喜欢读解谜故事书和画画。

script.text: What about this colourful art set and a cute sketch notebook?
script.zh: 这套彩色画笔和一本可爱的速写画册怎么样？

script.text: She will absolutely love it! Let us wrap it in shiny paper.
script.zh: 她绝对会超级喜欢！让我们用漂亮的彩纸把它包装起来吧。

theaters.title: At the Hospital
theaters.titleZh: 在诊所 · 勇敢小病号
theaters.tagline: 生病不用怕，医生阿姨温柔守护你的健康！

script.text: Hello Lucas, how are you feeling today?
script.zh: 你好卢卡斯，今天感觉怎么样？

script.text: I have a sore throat, but I drank plenty of warm water.
script.zh: 我有点喉咙痛，不过我已经喝了好多温水啦。

script.text: You are very brave! Let me check your temperature gently.
script.zh: 你真勇敢！让我轻轻地帮你量一下体温。

script.text: Thank you! I will take my vitamins and rest well.
script.zh: 谢谢阿姨！我会按时吃维生素好好休息的。

theaters.title: The Ticket Inspector
theaters.titleZh: 列车小乘客 · 礼貌检票
theaters.tagline: 搭乘开往伦敦的特快列车，向列车长出示车票！

script.text: Tickets please, ladies and gentlemen! Next stop is Victoria Station.
script.zh: 请出示车票，各位乘客！前方下一站是维多利亚火车站。

script.text: Here is my ticket, sir. My family is heading to the London Zoo!
script.zh: 给您车票，叔叔。我们一家正要去伦敦动物园呢！

script.text: All in order! The zoo is fantastic today, enjoy the lions and penguins!
script.zh: 车票完全没问题！今天的动物园非常棒，祝你们看狮子和企鹅玩得开心！

script.text: Thank you very much, have a nice day!
script.zh: 非常感谢您，祝您一天好心情！

theaters.title: Party Preparations
theaters.titleZh: 派对大筹备 · 欢乐时光
theaters.tagline: 吹气球、摆餐具，大家一起布置最炫酷的派对现场！

script.text: The guests will arrive in one hour! Are the colourful balloons ready?
script.zh: 客人们一个小时后就到了！彩色的气球都准备好了吗？

script.text: Yes! I have blown up twenty red and yellow balloons.
script.zh: 好啦！我已经吹好了二十个红黄相间的彩色气球。

script.text: Awesome! Now let us set up the juice cups and delicious cupcakes.
script.zh: 太棒啦！现在让我们摆好果汁杯和美味的小蛋糕吧。

script.text: Everything looks so festive! This is going to be the best party ever!
script.zh: 一切看起来都充满节日气氛！这一定会是最棒的一次派对！

theaters.title: Noises in the Dark
theaters.titleZh: 神秘的黑夜声响 · 勇敢小探险
theaters.tagline: 夜里传来窸窸窣窣的声音？拿上小手电筒一探究竟！

script.text: Sam, wake up! Did you hear that funny noise outside the bedroom door?
script.zh: 山姆快醒醒！你听到卧室门外那奇怪的声音了吗？

script.text: Do not worry, Chloe. I have my bright torch. Let us go check quietly.
script.zh: 别担心克洛伊，我拿了亮亮的手电筒。咱们悄悄去看看。

script.text: Look by the rug! It is just our cute fluffy kitten chasing a toy mouse!
script.zh: 快看地毯旁边！原来是我们那只毛茸茸的小猫咪在追玩具老鼠呀！

script.text: Haha, silly cat! Now we can sleep peacefully like little lions.
script.zh: 哈哈，顽皮的小猫！现在我们可以像小狮子一样安安稳稳睡觉啦。

theaters.title: Paying a Bill
theaters.titleZh: 餐厅结账 · 独立自主小达人
theaters.tagline: 学会礼貌跟服务员阿姨交流，核对餐单并结账！

script.text: Excuse me, miss! Could we have the bill, please?
script.zh: 打扰一下，阿姨！请问能帮我们结一下账吗？

script.text: Certainly! Did you enjoy the apple pie and strawberry ice cream?
script.zh: 当然可以！你们今天喜欢苹果派和草莓冰淇淋吗？

script.text: They were absolutely delicious! Here is the card to pay, thank you.
script.zh: 味道棒极了！这是结账的卡片，非常感谢您。

script.text: Thank you very polite young man! Have a wonderful sunny afternoon!
script.zh: 谢谢你这位懂礼貌的小朋友！祝你拥有一个阳光灿烂的下午！

theaters.title: The Wedding Dress
theaters.titleZh: 华丽的礼服 · 审美与设计
theaters.tagline: 洁白的丝绸与蕾丝刺绣，赞美生活中的美好细节！

script.text: Welcome to our studio, Sophie! What do you think of this white satin dress?
script.zh: 欢迎来到我们的工作室，苏菲！你觉得这件白缎礼服怎么样？

script.text: It is stunning! The lace flowers on the collar are so delicate.
script.zh: 太惊艳了！领口上的蕾丝花朵非常精致优美。

script.text: We stitched every little flower by hand with silk threads.
script.zh: 我们用真丝线亲手缝制了每一朵小花。

script.text: It looks like something from a royal fairy tale book!
script.zh: 看起来就像是从皇家童话书里走出来的一样！
